description: This pie chart illustrates the distribution of data categories used in the FineWeb-Edu Classifier dataset. The chart contains 20 slices, each representing a different educational category. The slices are labeled as follows: Policy 1 (light green), Manage 2 (light green), Emerging tech 4 (light green), Materials 1 (light green), Info tech 3 (orange), Teaching & resources 15 (dark orange), Fin & Law 3 (dark orange), Science & technology education 10 (purple), Society & culture 5 (purple), Tech & Engineer 12 (purple), History & Society 23 (red), Health & Medicine 22 (red), Diseases 11 (red), Nutrition 5 (yellow), Animal & Medical 6 (yellow), Events & people 6 (yellow), Historical review 7 (yellow), Materials 2 (blue), Animal & Plant 13 (blue), and Healthy education 2 (blue). Additionally, there are slices for Emerging tech 4 (light green), Materials 3 (light green), Teaching & resources 17 (dark orange), Society & culture 5 (purple), Tech & Engineer 8 (purple), History 19 (red), Science 15 (red), Health & Medicine 19 (red), Diseases 10 (red), Nutrition 7 (yellow), and Medical 2 (blue). The chart includes a legend identifying each category and its corresponding color. Percentage labels are not displayed directly on the slices, but the relative size of the slices suggests a visual ordering from larger to smaller proportions.
